# Logistics 0.2.1-alpha.12

- Open Transfers from mobile Workspaces to see native progress, completed activity and interrupted downloads that can resume.
- File Browser shows selection circles before filenames in List and Tiles and offers Move, Archive and Delete for the selected group. On iPhone and iPad, hold a file or folder over a destination to make the folder flash twice and open during the drag.
- iOS video shows previous and next chapter controls beside the ten-second skips when the video has chapters. AirPlay can retry at the last confirmed position after wake.
- Notebook cutouts wait for the PDF background to decode before copying its pixels with the ink and images.
- The Transfers icon next to Server shows live MB/s and per-file progress. Review Push and Pull changes in native controls, with the option to skip the preview.
- New document and New folder are in the Notes Library sidebar. File Browser details open over the current folder.
